title: DOOMSCROLLING | It Eats Your Hours
description:
Every night, a kind voice told him five more minutes. Every night, the thing in the dark ate a little more of his time, and the time of the one person who was running out of it.

DOOMSCROLLING | It Eats Your Hours is an animated short film about the habit that eats your hours in the dark, and the morning he finally put the phone away.

How many hours did you give the feed today? Tell me in the comments.

#shortfilm #animation #horror #selfimprovement #doomscrolling
